# SAKRA VISION

SAKRA VISION is an AI product studio founded by Likith Naidu Anumakonda.

The company builds real-world intelligent systems using AI/ML, computer vision, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, automation, and full-stack web technologies.

## Founder

Likith Naidu Anumakonda is the Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION. He is an AI/ML Engineer, Python Full-Stack Developer, CSE-AI student, IIT Patna Certified learner, pianist, author, and builder of real-world intelligent systems.

## Services

SAKRA VISION builds:
- AI applications
- Computer vision systems
- LLM and RAG tools
- AI agents
- Full-stack web products
- Automation systems
- Civic-tech platforms
- Event automation platforms
- Cloud-deployed intelligent systems

## Projects

Resolvit AI:
An AI-powered civic issue resolution platform connecting citizens, authorities, and NGOs.

SAKRA VISION Event Hub:
A smart event registration and operations platform with payment screenshot verification, admin approval, email automation, and backend workflows.

Bench AI:
An offline LLM + RAG learning assistant for students and classrooms.

Prometheus AI V2.0:
A local-first GenAI system focused on private AI interaction and edge-device intelligence.

AquaSentinel AI:
A marine intelligence platform using satellite data, weather APIs, mapping, and multilingual AI assistance.

AI Resume Builder:
A full-stack AI resume builder using Spring Boot, React, MySQL, and AI-generated summaries.

OpenCV Automation Tools:
Computer vision tools for image processing, object detection, verification, and visual automation.

## Technology

Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aiven Cloud, Groq API, Resend API, Cloudflare, OpenCV, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, JWT, REST APIs.
